# Bid the stop, not the lot size.

> Price a lawn care route stop from production rates: turf, beds, edging, travel time, fuel, dump, and margin — plus price per visit, in-season monthly, honest annual, and the walk-away number.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
